text:
Marta: Heads up — got a candidate email saying their interviewer didn't see the feedback form. Looks like feedback from yesterday's onsite didn't route into the new ATS queue.

Sam: ugh. Which candidate? is this consistent or one-off?

Marta: Candidate C1234 (julia@example.com). We had interviewers submit via link in the calendar invite. ATS webhooks show a 422 on form submission -> old_queue_id not found. :confused: 

Sam: @marta can you paste the webhook payload (sanitized) and the error? I'll check the Integrations config. Also did we roll the webhook change yesterday?

Marta: pasted below (sanitized): payload: {candidate_id: "C1234", form_id: "interviewer-feedback-v2", queue: "old_interviews"} error: "queue_not_found". We did a mapping update at ~12:30 yesterday to switch calendar form -> new_interview_queue.

June: this candidate's loop is mid-rotation — we can't lose a feedback. Is there a manual path to import feedback into the candidate timeline?

Alex: I can run a one-off patch via the ATS API to attach the feedback. Quick hack:

Alex: ```bash
curl -X POST https://ats.example.com/api/candidates/C1234/notes \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ATS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"source":"interviewer_form","body":"Positive, recommended"}'
```

Sam: thanks — I rolled back the webhook mapping at 12:40 to restore old_interviews. New plan: keep the old mapping for 24h while we backfill the failed events. Can we script a backfill for all failed webhook events?

Marta: yes. I can export the failed event IDs from the webhook logs (link: https://logs.example.com/teams/recruiting?query=queue_not_found). I'll drop the CSV into the shared /recruiting/backfill folder.

June: Also can we do a quick interviewer training refresh? Seems a chunk of folks still click the old form link in calendar invites. 20-min update + a calendar nudge would help. @sam @alex?

Sam: I'll put together a short doc + template updates. I'll also update the calendar invite default so new interviews use the new form link. @marta can you confirm which existing events need patching?

hr-bot: Reminder — interviewer calibration doc updated: https://docs.redwood.com/interviewer-calibration. Please review before Friday. :memo:

Alex: I'll write the backfill script now to POST the saved payloads into the candidate notes endpoint and mark the webhook events as processed. Will post status to #recruiter-ops. :thumbsup:

Marta: thanks all. Priority is: 1) backfill the failed events, 2) fix calendar templates, 3) quick comms to interviewers. Will follow up with a checklist later today.
